title: Reference: fast-eval $800 up to a 40-pt stop + room 60%
question: Owner order 2026-10-18: an MFFU 50K eval must be passed within 10 sessions; maximise P(pass in 10) and minimise $91.80 / P(pass in 10).
verdict: Fast-eval $800/40 + room 60% (reference). 50K: H1 starts (pick) pass/fail/open within 10 sessions 47.1/5.9/47.0% (n 119), within 20 72.5/21.1%, cost per 2-week pass $195.0, worst day $-1,004, max at risk $853; H2 starts (check) pass/fail/open within 10 sessions 44.9/0.0/55.1% (n 69), within 20 54.2/13.6%, cost per 2-week pass $204.0, worst day $-1,006, max at risk $834; 2026 pass/fail/open within 10 sessions 44.2/3.6/52.2% (n 197), within 20 59.9/17.6%, cost per 2-week pass $208.0, worst day $-1,006, max at risk $853; Monte Carlo 4,000 x 20 sessions (5-session blocks): H1 45.1/4.8/50.1, H2 41.3/4.0/54.7; 2021-25 reference (5m) 12.9/5.7. Back to back (new eval after a pass, a fail or 10 sessions): 2026 13 passes in 28 evals ($198 a pass), 2021-25 17 in 117 ($632). 25K ($63, every $ halved): H1 50.4/10.9, H2 43.5/10.1, cost per 2-week pass H1 $125.0 / H2 $145.0.
method: LIT replay (engine/lit.py run_x, the same code as the live loop engine/lit_live.py): 2026 entries on 1-minute bars, 2021-25 on 5-minute bars (reference); live sizing + weekly stop; costs included
